I had this game in my library for a very long time. For most of the time I didn't like it since it was at best a barely-playable PoC - weird game modes, weird AIs, and totally unrealistic weapon handling (I've seen real world complete rookies manage recoil better).
But after this v0.14 update that just came out at the time I am writing this, things has changed a lot. You have realistic recoil, you have bipods/mounts to help you make better shots, and you have a much wider range of weapons to select from.
I AM STARTING TO HAVE QUITE A BIT OF FUN WITH THIS GAME!
I have a skill issue, needs optimizing but otherwise very promising.
